en: The image depicts a colorized, vintage postcard showing a wide street flanked by grand European-style buildings. Several people in early 20th-century attire are visible, walking along the sidewalks and street. The sky is pastel blue and pink, suggesting a hand-tinted process typical of old postcards. The street scene is framed in an oval with a decorative border. The lower part of the image has text in French, and there is a watermark from an archive.
